author: Benjamin Franklin
title: Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin
edition: New York: Henry Holt and Company, Frank Woodworth Pine edition, copyright and title-page date 1916; the transcribed copy also records June, 1922. Publication year here records that printing. Project Gutenberg eBook 20203. Franklin’s original English only; editor introductions, notes, note-reference links, page numbers, and illustration captions excluded. Source spelling and punctuation retained; line-wrap whitespace normalized; decorative initial-letter image alt text retained as source letters. The library work holds the whole Autobiography (chapters I-XIX) with Pine's chapter divisions and titles, which his introduction says are the editor's; his introduction, notes, appendix selections and bibliography are not held.

rights.basis: The downloaded edition identifies Henry Holt, copyright 1916, and June 1922 printing. Both predate 1931 and the US term has expired. Project Gutenberg explicitly records Public domain in the USA for this English edition; no modern introduction or translation is used.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 20203 HTML from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org, converted with a scratch walker over the part from the AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF BENJAMIN FRANKLIN title to the APPENDIX heading: the PG header and footer, Pine's front matter and introduction, the appendix selections and bibliography are outside it. Removed footnotes, footnote anchors, illustrations, image-only tables (facsimiles) and captions; italic styling dropped and line-wrap whitespace joined. Decorative initial-letter images become their alt letter joined to the following word (a space is supplied after the pronoun in I BEGAN and I HAD). The title lines form one level-1 heading; each chapter numeral and Pine's chapter title (with XIII's dates) form one level-2 heading. Runs of centred lines (the parents' epitaph) and verse quotations are stanzas with lines trimmed; single centred lines are paragraphs; Franklin's virtue chart and daily schedule are paragraphs with one tab-separated line per table row (empty rows dropped, rowspans not repeated). The mail-file escape “>From” that the Project Gutenberg text carries inside one paragraph (where a line beginning From was escaped and then joined) was corrected to From on 2026-11-18.
